question.prompt: A picture \(3\) feet across is hung in the center of a wall that is \(19\) feet wide. How many feet from the end of the wall is the nearest edge of the picture?

solutions.explanation:
Because the picture is centered, the empty spaces on its left and right have equal widths. Together these spaces measure
\[
19-3=16\text{ feet}.
\]
Each space is half of that total:
\[
16\div2=8\text{ feet}.
\]
The nearest edge of the picture is \(8\) feet from either end of the wall, choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
solutions.title: Share the remaining width equally
